content_md: Judy Brady’s 1971 [I Want a Wife](https://www.sevanoland.com/uploads/1/1/8/0/118081022/_brady_i_want_a_wife.pdf) is the *real* spec for personal agents, and the *real* market is the household COO and default parent, whoever that may be. The job-to-be-done isn’t [Zwang’s luxury tea purchasing and personal MMA video analysis](https://youtu.be/XfdIhd1g6EI), and the market isn’t high-functioning individuals looking to 100x their agency. The bar to clear is status. Agents take off if or when having one signals what having a wife used to: *someone else runs my life.*
